references.text: The same introductory formula, 'The Lord spoke to Moses and said,' is used consistently throughout Leviticus to introduce divine instructions.
The Lord speaks directly to Moses and gives him instructions that are to be passed on to the people of Israel.
The same wording is used at the beginning of Numbers, where the Lord speaks to Moses in the tent of meeting.
The preceding context in Numbers uses the same introduction when the Lord gives Moses various laws and regulations.
The same pattern occurs where the Lord speaks to Moses with instructions that are to be given further to the children of Israel.
